activity: Call one trusted supplier and confirm substitute ingredients, quantities, and delivery timing rather than improvising alone.
Redesign the affected dishes around the ingredients still available, tasting small trials and writing the revised preparation notes.
Taste the trial dishes with the kitchen team, adjust seasoning and portions, and explain the changes clearly.
Eat a simple staff lunch away from the desk and drink from the thermos while reviewing the revised menu.
Finalize substitute orders, update prep quantities, and send the kitchen team a concise list of the new priorities.
Take a short break outside the restaurant, drink water, and let the first wave of resentment settle before service preparation.
Prepare the revised dishes, organize the station, and brief the front and back of house on substitutions and likely guest questions.
Run dinner service and closing duties, checking the redesigned dishes as they leave the kitchen and supporting the team through the crowded service.
